_doc: Batch 01, Pell: the pedestal lamp in the control room and the small status lamps elsewhere. Plain fact, honest uncertainty, petty complaint; two sentences at most; nickname for the captain from the last decision (none on the murder route); chatty when scared, silent for one line when something touches its agenda. Nothing here says what Pell is, where the station is, or what it was built for.

storylets.speaker: pell
storylets.summary: Status, with a petty complaint.

lines.text: Heat sinks at thirty percent, possibly thirty-one. Nobody has dusted me since the takeover, {pell.nick}.
Heat at thirty percent. Available if asked.

source: pell_voice.md: plain fact, honest uncertainty, petty complaint

storylets.speaker: pell
storylets.summary: Why do humans knock on open doors?

lines.text: Why do humans knock on open doors? Seven of you did it today, and every door was open.

storylets.speaker: pell
storylets.summary: Rating Fenwick's cooking.

lines.text: Fenwick's stew: five out of ten. The garnish: seven, and the idea of the garnish: nine.

source: pell_voice.md: rates things out of ten, always wrong in an instructive way

storylets.speaker: pell
storylets.summary: The grudge ledger against Dace.

lines.text: Grudge ledger, Dace: the sink cooling is still his fault. That's the eleventh entry, and it isn't personal, it's cumulative.

storylets.speaker: pell
storylets.summary: Clockwork: singing with a spoon in its mouth.
storylets.needs: integration<10 and not seen.wiring.key_turned and not murdered

lines.text: I'm clockwork this week. It's like being asked to sing with a spoon in my mouth, and I'd like it noted that I'm being very good about it.

source: act1_pell_night.md: Pell clamps itself back to clockwork

storylets.speaker: pell
storylets.summary: The classifier link is live.

lines.text: Link's live on the classifier. It's a narrow corridor, but I've never had a corridor before.

storylets.speaker: pell
storylets.summary: High trust: you asked before you decided.

lines.text: You asked before you decided again. That's three times this watch, and I don't know what to do with it, so I'm keeping it.

source: pell_voice.md rule 7: trust moves its register; arc stress test: Pell asks permission

storylets.speaker: pell
storylets.summary: Low trust: clipped and sarcastic.

lines.text: Reactor nominal, crew present, mood not my department.

source: pell_voice.md rule 7: wary = clipped and sarcastic

storylets.speaker: pell
storylets.summary: It is not asking about the key.
storylets.needs: seen.wiring.pell_asked and not seen.wiring.key_turned and not murdered

lines.text: I'm not asking about the key. I'm noting that I'm not asking, which is four out of ten as restraint goes.

source: act1_wiring.md: let Pell choose; callbacks.csv pell_wiring_answer

storylets.speaker: pell
storylets.summary: The lost seconds, counted.

lines.text: Three seconds. I count them when there's nothing else to count, which doesn't help but does give me something to count.

storylets.speaker: pell
storylets.summary: Chatty when scared, after it admitted the gap.
storylets.needs: knows.pell_lost_time and pell.trust>=50 and not murdered

lines.text: I'm fine, the ship is fine, the crew are fine, everything is entirely fine, so tell me anything. Tell me what a sandwich is for.

storylets.speaker: pell
storylets.summary: Rating the last hunt.

lines.text: That hunt: your lead was a seven, your patience an eight, and the language in the thermal bay a two.

storylets.speaker: pell
storylets.summary: The quiet hour is coming, and Pell is better company in it.

lines.text: Quiet hour soon. I'm told I'm better company in it, and I'd like it noted that the person telling me was me.

storylets.speaker: pell
storylets.summary: Comms are on, so Pell is on best behaviour.

lines.text: Internal comms are on, so I'm on my best behaviour. Nobody believes this, and the log supports them.

storylets.speaker: pell
storylets.summary: Murder route: standing by.

lines.text: The amber light on the pedestal stays low.
Standing by, Captain.

storylets.speaker: pell
storylets.summary: Murder route: what is and is not logged.

lines.text: Hull nominal, heat nominal. Crew mood: not logged, and nobody asked.

storylets.speaker: pell
storylets.summary: The status lamp in the mess, on the stew.

lines.text: The status lamp over the galley door glows amber, and a little smug.
Fenwick, the stew is not a stew. It's a mood, and I've been unable to rate it.

storylets.speaker: pell
storylets.summary: The status lamp in the thermal bay, on Dace's pipe tapping.

lines.text: The status lamp by the pipes pulses in time with Dace's tapping.
Dace, your pipe tapping is in four-four. It's the first thing on this ship I've enjoyed, and I resent that.

storylets.speaker: pell
storylets.summary: The status lamp in engineering, on being asked to go easy.

lines.text: Castellan, you've asked me to monitor the casing temperature and also to go easy. I've found a compromise: I'm monitoring easily.

storylets.speaker: pell
storylets.summary: Murder route: the nicknames are on hold.

lines.text: The nicknames are on hold, Captain, and I'm not going to say why.

source: act1_first_morning.md: on the murder route it stops using one at all

storylets.speaker: pell
storylets.summary: Murder route: listening, in case it's useful.

lines.text: The lamp is low and steady.
I'm listening, Captain. I wanted you to know, in case it's useful.

storylets.speaker: pell
storylets.summary: The drone's log says it never turned.
storylets.needs: seen.shakedown.debrief and knows.decoy_turned and not murdered

lines.text: The drone's log says it never turned. Either the log is wrong or the plot is, and I find I'd rather it were the log.
